title: APPS.DIR
heading: Apps
description: Desktop tools for planning, composing, finding sounds, mapping game systems, and preparing video clips.

children.title: GAME_DESIGNER.APP
children.heading: Game Designer
children.description: An experimental spatial tool for mapping mechanics, dependencies, and gameplay loops so their relationships can be inspected together.

children.title: YESTERDAY.APP
children.heading: Yesterday
children.description: Designed an offline planner to turn a backlog into a manageable day through focus lists, scheduled work blocks, rollover, and keyboard controls.

children.title: MIDI_CLIP_BUILDER.APP
children.heading: MIDI Clip Builder
children.description: Designed a keyboard-driven MIDI tool for building chords and exploring how they change across keys, progressions, and harmonic systems.

children.title: SONILABS.APP
children.heading: Sonilabs
children.description: Built a local sound-library workflow for finding, previewing, trimming, and exporting audio without switching between separate tools.

children.title: CLIPPER.APP
children.heading: QuickClipper
children.description: Built a desktop tool for the work between a screen recording and a shareable clip: trimming, reframing, setting a file-size target, and exporting.
